title: Concept: Maven server password stored in settings.xml
description: settings.xml declares a repository password written directly into the checked-in Maven settings, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Repository readers can publish or pull as the account, and the credential cannot be scoped or expired like a token.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through settings.xml (maven).
risk: Repository readers can publish or pull as the account, and the credential cannot be scoped or expired like a token.
